comparison.objective: Extract and recover a fitted collar using a prepared screw puller.
comparison.physical_skill: Engage an extraction tool, apply controlled screw-driven pulling force, and capture the freed collar.
comparison.success_condition: Collar removed and recovered without loss or prohibited damage to the part or fixture.
comparison.reason: Despite both involving a collar and screw manipulation, this record tests axial extraction of a fitted part. The candidate collar stays installed and is rotated to tune damping, locked, and verified through impacts.
